The '''Citadel of Axes''' was a citadel located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] and, according to the native [[Kelrodoan]]s, the facility was millennia old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] forces began to operate from the citadel, and during the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Imperial forces were dispatched to the world to drive the Separatists from the fortress. In the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|resulting battle]], the Empire's [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]], under the command of the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], disabled the citadel's [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]], and the Imperial forces were ultimately victorious.
